Canvas: Frank's office — the new arrangement (scene_office_after_crack) | Node: Frank's office — the new arrangement



The door's closed. It stays closed every evening now. Has since the night he closed it himself — the night the lamp was low and he set the pen down and changed his mind. She still doesn't know what changed his mind, only that something did, and the receipts are still on the desk every evening because the bookkeeping is still happening, only it's not really bookkeeping anymore and they both know it.

He's at the desk when she comes in. Page open. Pen in his hand. Lamp on. Same as before, same as always — only the door's closed behind her now.

Frank: Sit.

She sits.

Bend over the page.

She straightens. Pushes the skirt back down. Steps out from between him and the desk.

Frank doesn't move. His hand stays in the air for a second where her hip just was, then drops. He sets the pen down on the page. Doesn't pick it back up.

She picks up the receipts off the middle stack. Holds them against her chest.

Frank: Door's behind you.

He doesn't look at her. She doesn't look at him.










Leave the receipts. Walk out.

Canvas: Frank's bedroom — first night (scene_franks_bedroom_evening) | Node: Frank's bedroom — first night, refuse



She doesn't move. The room is too small. The wall on his right is the wall it is. Her hand finds the doorknob behind her without looking.

Frank stops where he is. Doesn't step closer. Doesn't say anything for a long second. Then he sits back down in the chair and picks the paperback off the nightstand and opens it to the page he wasn't reading.

Frank: Door's still open.

He doesn't look at her. She turns the knob and steps back into the hallway and pulls the door shut behind her. The latch clicks soft. She walks back down the hallway the way she came.










Walk back to your room.

body_text:
Canvas: Frank's bedroom — first night (scene_franks_bedroom_evening) | Node: Frank's bedroom — first night, climax



Two words. The wall on his right is the one Diana's room shares. Maya knows it without having to look — the angle the bed sits, the way the lamp would throw shadow if it were brighter, the boards under her feet that don't squeak anymore because Frank's already on them, crossing to her.

His hand on the back of her neck. Brief. Then his other hand on her hip and he's walking her backwards to the bed without speaking.

Frank: Quiet.

Always the same word. He sits her on the edge of the bed and stands over her for a long second with his hand at her jaw, looking down at her, the lamp behind him so his face is half dark. Then he kneels and pushes her skirt up and his mouth finds the inside of her thigh and stays there, and the only sound in the room is her breath catching and the wall on his right being the wall it is.

Later — the lamp still on, the cover pulled half back, his weight beside her in a bed that is not the desk and not the office and not pretending — he says it again, softer, almost to himself.

Frank: Quiet.



She doesn't stay quiet. Not all the way. Half-words breaking through her teeth, her hand finding his jaw, her hips moving against his without thinking. The clock somewhere down the hallway clicks over to a new hour. He doesn't tell her to be quiet again.








Stay through. Sleep here.
Back to my room before Diana wakes.

Canvas: Frank — kitchen, morning (scene_kitchen_with_frank_morning) | Node: Kitchen — Frank, morning




Frank had the receipts in two stacks at his elbow when she came in. He'd put the smaller one on her side of the table without waiting for her to sit. The kettle was still warm. He didn't look up — but the wait wasn't the same wait as last week.

Frank: Coffee's still warm.
Frank: You sleep alright in there?
Take the cup.

Canvas: Hallway — Frank's bedroom door (scene_hallway_franks_door_evening) | Node: Hallway — Frank's bedroom door



She passes the door at the end of the hallway. It's closed, the way it's been closed every evening since the invitation. The lamp is on inside — she can see the warm line of it under the door — and the room is quiet the way the room is quiet when Frank's reading and waiting both at once.

Diana's door is on the right, halfway down the hall. Two rooms over and a wall between. Maya doesn't slow down passing it. She doesn't speed up either.








Continue.
